name: rename-vs-edit
description: Upstream renames the helper lineTotal to subtotal; the change adds a discount next to the line that calls it. The resolved loop must call the new name.

plan.title: Cart discount
plan.intent: cartTotal takes an optional discount that is subtracted from the total, never going below zero.

plan.title: Rename lineTotal to subtotal
plan.intent: Use the accounting term subtotal for price times quantity.
acceptanceCriteria: no function is called lineTotal any more
